description: Build the app from source. mode:"plan" (default, no side effects): commands, cwd, expected artifacts, toolchain status. mode:"run" (consent-gated job, needs sessionId): runs them, stores the build log, re-resolves the artifact. Failures are typed (GRADLE_FAILED, XCODEBUILD_FAILED, ...) and are not test failures.

projectRoot.description: plan: resolve the project without a session.

sessionId.description: Required for run (stores the build log).

name: qa_build
title: Plan or run a build from source
